name: peak_big_win
prompt:
Slot-game win title lettering on a fully transparent background, nothing else: the words "BIG WIN" on one line in huge chunky rounded bold cartoon letters in exactly the attached HIGH PEAKS logo's lettering style - letters made of bright icy sky-blue ice with a lighter blue highlight, a thick white snow cap dripping over the top of every letter with tiny icicles, a thick even black outline, a flat deep navy blue drop extrusion under the letters, a few small white sparkles. The lettering fills the picture's width with a small margin. No background, no plate, no banner, no other words. Higher quality and a little more detailed than before: crisp clean ink lines, more small texture lines in the snow, rock and wood, more depth layers - but still flat cartoon colours, readable at a glance.

Style: flat 2D adult-animation TV cartoon (late-night animated sitcom look). Thick, even, confident black outlines; flat cel colours with at most one simple hard-edged shadow tone and one small white highlight; bright saturated candy colours; chunky, rounded, slightly goofy proportions; simple readable shapes. NO realistic lighting, NO gradients, NO painterly texture, NO 3D render, NO photo. Clean vector-like finish.
